mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.member_id AS memberId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.status AS status, o.final_amount AS finalAmount, o.pickup_at AS pickupAt, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '연동 주문 상품' WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(product_name) ELSE CONCAT(MIN(product_name), ' 외 ', COUNT(*) - 1, '건') END FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id ) AS representativeProductName FROM orders o WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
